name: Viscer Nursing II
summary:
VisceR Nursing II is an immersive VR clinical training experience designed for nursing students and healthcare learners. The pack focuses on pediatric care and essential clinical skills, allowing learners to practice procedures in a safe, repeatable, risk-free virtual environment.

PAEDIATRIC CARE
• IV Cannulation
• Nebulization Setup
• IM Injection Administration
• Fever Management
• Oral Rehydration Therapy
• Oral Medication Administration

CLINICAL ASSESSMENT & PROCEDURES
• Nasal Swab Collection
• Visual
